svg.title: Recovering two lost drives with two parity equations
svg.desc: Five drives with D1 and D2 lost. Parity P and Q give two equations in two unknowns, which are solved step by step to recover D2 = 4 and D1 = 3.
svg.text: Real RAID 6 does the same steps in GF(2⁸): "+" becomes XOR, weights become powers of 2
